about: Sign-offs for the release gate (edakit gate) of the perfboard variant. Each counts only for the hash of its scope: 'circuit' = state_sha256, 'electrical' = electrical_sha256, 'layout' = layout_sha256 (the plan with the footprint data), 'fab' = fab_sha256 (the drawings and lists the gate writes into fab/main/). Parts are signed in their parts entry (field 'verified').

manual.text: Critical parts (BT1, D1) checked a second time against the datasheet, independently – the agent electrical-reviewer in its own session
manual.note: M-1: OK for state c1ffee3ad4c336ae95011a09732f20567d985552bfbfa2453931050ec9ea7de9; requirements met: R-1, R-2. Changed since da4d9070 (OK there too): the reviewer's notes applied – D1 rs_ohm 8 (p. 5) and VR 5 V from IR ≤ 10 µA at VR = 5 V (p. 3), BT1's lead per pin and height 8.9 mm, the graph's layout note for this holder. R-1: 1.92 mA at used/vf-max against 1 mA; R-2: leakage under 0.05 µA against 1 µA. Notes, none blocking: no moulded '+' on the holder – the clip end is plus; C5365915's open item names this plan's hole; D1's solder joint 2 mm from the epoxy (datasheet p. 3). Datasheets Kinghelm KH-CR2032-2-1 rev F 9b2ef878…, XINGLIGHT XL-504SURD 477fa83a…, read 2026-11-10.

manual.text: Regulatory review: circuit and parts against EU law for the purpose in the graph – the agent regulatory-reviewer in its own session. No finding 'block' open. Support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed
manual.note: M-6: OK for state c1ffee3ad4c336ae95011a09732f20567d985552bfbfa2453931050ec9ea7de9 (electrical fee1183debdfe2f6813758d77e3ee523a5e708f314a7f803394d028f70f1e3f4) and purpose private. Changed since da4d9070 (OK there too): data only (D1 rs_ohm and VR source, BT1 height, sim numbers in texts) – no part, net, purpose, requirement or compliance block. Notes, none blocking: EMC benign by EMVG § 2(3) Nr. 2 (judgement); coin cell removable by hand, adults only (D-5); spent cell to collection (BattDG § 6), board separately at end of life (ElektroG § 10); RoHS stated for all four parts, REACH and the perfboard, wire and solder unstated – no duty for private; no purpose.country, German references; a board given away or sold needs a new M-6. manual.text: The perfboard plan reviewed independently (buildability, mechanics, operation, looks) on the drawings and lists of a gate run with this plan – the agent pcb-reviewer. No finding 'block' open, every 'important' finding fixed or rejected by the owner
manual.note: M-5: OK for fab f684ecb1f5d2bdc176af52762534536097987cef9e7d8965b6bf9ae840d245ff; layout 43bf60f797efe96aa59677d763c85a1dca896ddd40af4cb284c1caf947df7d8a. Gate run 20261110-090401, fab/main/ reviewed in full. The first round's important findings fixed in edakit perfboard: BT1's ends marked + and − and no '(stripe)' in its build row; the build list says a wire's stripped end is soldered with the lead in its pad. Also fixed: the GND wire enters at J1, clear of D1's flange; the legend names only this board's marks; the wires' colours in step 2. Notes, none blocking: the build row could name the metal clip as the + end; the GND wire along row 1 clears D1's flange by about 0.06 mm with 1.6 mm insulation – thin wire, or D1 seated just clear; trim the stripped end J1→J2 to J2's pad. Left out as notes: more tests in the test list, the cut line, a mirrored bottom view, feet.
